title: LateFeesAssessed
description: Emitted when a late fee is assessed against a loan (flat $25 for <=30 days past due, otherwise 5% of the outstanding balance capped at $50).

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the aggregate (the loan id).

paymentId.description: Identifier of the fee record created in the payment service.

daysPastDue.description: Number of days the loan is past due, driving the fee schedule.
